title: Balances frame
description: The `balances` topic of decision 0003a (decision 6): one frame per source, derived by src/domain/balances/derive.ts from the last good reads, served by src/runtime/account/topics.ts with `sourceId` and `assets` for the panel. Every figure is a string; `null` means the venue does not state it in this mode, distinct from a row whose `state` is `unavailable`. In unified and portfolio-margin accounts every per-dex money field is null. With an unknown mode every mode-dependent figure is null. No figure is a JSON number.

balanceState.description: Public Binance read summary. Raw internal wallet groups are not published; older frames may retain groups.

accountValue.description: 0040 A2 d61: held runtime yardstick for bot sizing, including unrealized PnL. Optional for older peers; absence is unknown, never Available.

walletValues.description: Quote-only venue valuations counted instead of asset detail, never holdings or available collateral. Binance PM/Pro uses the selected pool actualEquity in USD; components remain non-additive details and P/R/O retain incomplete. USD is already dollar value. Absent on older frames defaults to no value-only owners; existing spot/collateral/extra rows still count.

binanceModes.description: Confirmed signed mode reads. Missing means unknown. Account mode selects private routes; a failed read retains its last route stale and never sends a setting.

venue.description: Additive (0037 B4): the venue namespace. Absent retains Hyperliquid's existing mode and token-index semantics. Binance has no Hyperliquid token index and reports independently read wallet totals even though its shared mode is unknown.

groups.description: Additive (0037 B4): named wallet reads using the venue-neutral Group union from src/domain/balances/groups.ts. Absent on older frames. Empty wallets are hidden; a stale wallet retains its last holdings and time; loading/unread counts zero.

extra.description: Additive (0037 B4): amounts in additional wallets, separate from spot and collateral; stale amounts still count. Absent means no additional-wallet amounts.

sourceId.description: The same as `source`, as the panel reads it (roadmap P3; added, optional).

assets.description: The panel's free balance per spot token: its total less what is held, as the spot read gave them (roadmap P3; added, optional). Absent while the spot state was never read, so the panel waits rather than show 0.

assetsUnread.description: The spot wallet's first read failed, so `assets` is absent and the panel says the figure was not read yet rather than wait (added, optional). Absent on older frames.

own.description: A vault's only (added, optional): its main account's own equity in it, USDC, from Hyperliquid's `userVaultEquities` (RULINGS 99 (a): a vault you lead counts your own share, never the followers' money). The Dashboard counts this figure for the vault; the vault's other figures are the whole vault's, for trading on it. `total` null with `state` unavailable until a read answered; stale when the read after the last good one failed.

token.description: Hyperliquid spot token index of the collateral; null for Binance, whose asset has no such index.

unrealizedPnl.description: Added by C71/MH170: sum of open positions’ unrealised PnL on this collateral’s dexes, from the same snapshot, in collateral units. The Portfolio total includes it in owned equity; this component is detail, never added a second time. Absent on older wire means zero. Unified/portfolio margin uses spot only and omits this field.

asOf.description: Receipt time: spot state carries no venue time.

money.description: A plain decimal string; no JSON numbers, exponents or nonnumeric text.

figure.description: A canonical decimal string, or null when the venue does not state it in this mode.
